protocol: Digit OCR (tesseract, psm 7, digit whitelist, 3x upscale) on fixed crops; the script never opens the master, which is compared after OCR. The coin-free crop (610,586,640,610) was chosen after seeing the sample of ten, so the 10-round figure is tuned; the 21-frame run is the out-of-sample figure.
